messages:
jamie: Friendly ping — I need to land PR #17925 (db schema + canary flag) before Friday's deploy blackout. CI queue is ~2h, branch needs a quick rebase. Can reviewers please ping if they can take a look? Thanks :pray:
alex: I can review but I'll be offline after 4pm PT. Please rebase now and push — if CI flakes we can request a rerun slot.
jamie: Rebased and pushed ✨
jamie: CI shows 'queued' on mac/win/linux, position ~12, estimated start ~1h.
ci-bot: Job queued on runners (position 12). Link: https://ci.redwood.example/queue/17925
morgan: I'll do a pass — focus on migration backward-compat + feature-flag gating.
sam: small reminder: can we add a short RELEASE_NOTES.md blurb? product folks will ask.
morgan: left two tiny comments on the PR (nits). Nothing blocking.
alex: left approval in the PR, will mark LGTM once green. :thumbsup:
li: quick safety check on the migration script now.
li: tested locally with minimal dataset, migration is idempotent — looks good.
jamie: thanks — if CI flakes, please react :eyes: and we'll escalate for a prioritized rerun.
alex: FYI if CI stays queued >2h, ping eng-oncall to bump job priority.
jamie: Commands I ran to rebase/push:
```
git fetch origin
git checkout feature/db-pr-17925
git rebase origin/main
git push --force-with-lease
```
jamie: linux job passed, mac still running.
morgan: i'll trigger a mac re-run if it flakes.
ci-bot: Job mac/17925 started.
ci-bot: Job mac/17925 passed.
ci-bot: All checks passed ✅
alex: merging now — performing canary landing.
jamie: Merge pushed, canary rollout started.
sam: noted, I'll add the release-note line in the release doc.
jamie: Thanks all for quick turnaround — closing the loop. :party_parrot:
